messages.content: The schedule has changed again. Saturday now runs through late afternoon, so I am keeping the Sunday morning nonstop. Please compare the two hotels for Thursday through Sunday and include the real three-night totals, not just nightly rates.

For June 11-14, the conference hotel, Boston Park Plaza, totals $1,146 including estimated taxes and its mandatory destination charge. The smaller Chandler Inn totals $918 including taxes, with no separate destination fee. The Chandler is $228 less for the stay.
How much inconvenience does the cheaper one add for Friday's 8:30 start and the Saturday meetings?

Boston Park Plaza is attached to the meeting space, so Friday morning is an indoor walk of about 3 minutes. From the Chandler, allow roughly 11 minutes on foot, all outdoors, or about 9-15 minutes using the nearby bus once waiting time is included. The same difference applies Saturday; the meetings are at the Park Plaza both days.
I have the Thursday dinner at 6:30 there too. Would the cheaper hotel still be reasonable after arriving Thursday morning?

Yes. Your flight arrives at 12:50 p.m., and a taxi or rideshare should put you at either hotel around 1:50-2:30 after the checked bag. Even if the Chandler room is not ready, you can leave the bag, then walk to the Park Plaza for dinner. It is workable, but it adds another outdoor round trip that evening.
Now compare cancellation and deposits. I do not want a low headline total that becomes nonrefundable.

The quoted Park Plaza option is cancellable without charge until 6:00 p.m. local time on Monday, June 8. It requires a one-night room-and-tax deposit of $382 when reserved; cancellation after the deadline or a no-show forfeits that deposit. The Chandler rate is cancellable until 3:00 p.m. local time on Sunday, June 7, and takes the full $918 at booking. After its deadline, the full stay is nonrefundable.
What happens Sunday morning? The flight leaves at 8:40, and I will have one checked bag.

From the Park Plaza, the desk and bell service operate around the clock. You can settle the bill Saturday night, check out around 5:20 a.m., and take a prearranged taxi or rideshare at 5:30. That targets Logan around 5:50-6:05, leaving more than two and a half hours for the 8:40 nonstop. The Chandler desk is staffed only from 7:00 a.m.; it allows an early key drop, but any bill correction or luggage assistance would wait until staff arrive. A car can still pick you up there at 5:25.
So transit does not really save the Chandler on Sunday?

Correct. Public transit would require an early walk and at least one transfer, with less predictable service at that hour. For either hotel, a taxi or rideshare is the practical choice. The estimated fare difference between the two pickup points is negligible.

Choose the Park Plaza. The extra $228 is justified by the indoor access, later cancellation deadline, and staffed early departure. Put together exactly what should go into the reservation, but do not book it.

Reservation-ready details: Elena Ruiz, one adult traveling alone; Boston Park Plaza; check in Thursday, June 11 and check out Sunday, June 14; three nights; one standard king room; displayed tax-inclusive total $1,146, including the mandatory destination charge; one-night room-and-tax deposit of $382 due at reservation. Cancellation is without charge through 6:00 p.m. Boston time Monday, June 8; afterward, or for a no-show, the deposit is forfeited. Add an arrival note estimating 2:00-2:30 p.m. Thursday and an early-departure note for approximately 5:20 a.m. Sunday. Plan a prearranged car for 5:30 a.m. to Logan for the 8:40 a.m. nonstop to Denver. Nothing is booked. Before purchase, verify live room inventory, the final itemized total, deposit posting date, cancellation wording and time zone, guaranteed bed type, standard check-in time, 24-hour checkout and bell service, and whether an early-departure fee applies.
